MATCH (p:Passage)-[:CONTAINS_DOCTRINE]->(d:Doctrine)
WITH p, d,
  toLower(coalesce(d.name, 'lit_1')) AS var_1,
  toLower(coalesce(d.definition, 'lit_1')) AS var_2,
  toLower(coalesce(p.summary, 'lit_1')) AS var_3
WITH p, d,
  (CASE WHEN var_1 CONTAINS 'lit_2' OR var_2 CONTAINS 'lit_2' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN var_2 CONTAINS 'lit_3' OR var_3 CONTAINS 'lit_3' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN var_1 CONTAINS 'lit_4' OR var_2 CONTAINS 'lit_4' THEN 7 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN var_2 CONTAINS 'lit_5' OR var_3 CONTAINS 'lit_5' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN var_2 CONTAINS 'lit_6' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN var_2 CONTAINS 'lit_7' OR var_3 CONTAINS 'lit_7' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) AS score
WHERE score > 0
WITH p, d, score ORDER BY score DESC, d.uid ASC
WITH p, max(score) AS score, head(collect(d)) AS best
OPTIONAL MATCH (best)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(e:Element)
RETURN p.row_index AS row_index,
  p.summary AS source_summary,
  best.definition AS doctrine_definition,
  collect(DISTINCT {element_number: e.number, description: e.description}) AS elements,
  score
ORDER BY score DESC, row_index ASC LIMIT 20
